title: Employment Record of Services Amendment Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Employment Record of Services Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 2011
ACT XI OF 2011
EMPLOYMENT (RECORD OF SERVICES) (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the Employment
(Record of Services) Act, 1951
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary,
2nd May, 2011
No. PAP-Legis-2(64)/2011/389, dated 2-5-2011.--The Employment (Record of
Services) (Amendment) Bill 2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab on 30 March 2011, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab
on 30 April 2011, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient
further to amend the Employment (Record of Services) Act, 1951 (XIX of 1952)
for purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be cited as the Employment (Record of Services) (Amendment) Act,
2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
